item.tib: tshe dbang dz+wa this rigs lnga'i dbal chu ma dag kun sel
item.coloph: de ltar dag byed dbal chu khol ma 'di/ phyi rabs don du pha nor bu la bzhag nam zhig bon chos bstan pa dar nub skabs/sprul pa'i sku ldan gshed bzhi lo pa der/ dag snang brten (rten) 'brel rnam pa lnga shar tshe/ dus babs btang bzhag srung mas pho nya rem// phyis su gshen spral thugs rje nyi mas zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug byang nub mtshams su dbal ri'i gnas tshab phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i gnas kyi nye 'dabs brag dmar tsi ta ba'i ngos nas gter gyi dngos grub tu bzhes te lo mang bka' rgya bsdoms nas bkrol ba'i dus rkyen ngan dbang gis mthar ma grub cing*/ rtsa 'gag tu song ba la/ khyung za skal bzang lha mo yum sras dang / bon dkar ye tshul rgyal bstan bcas nas rten 'brel sna bdun gyi mtshams sbyar nas snga mo nas bskur (bskul) ba dang / phyis su hor blon skal bzang bkra shis dang / dad slob phur bu bkra shis sogs don gnyer can du ma nas bskul byung ngor/ kho bo dbra pa bla ma o rgyan zil gnon bzhed pa bdag gis dag snang brda' ris la brten nas bod yig tu gtan phab pa'o//
